Method of Attack: Exploiting misconfigured noSql databases (MongoDB, CouchDB, Elasticsearch) to access sensitive data
Full administrative privileges via unprotected Elasticsearch cluster
Remote code execution to steal or destroy data
Attack Vector: Unprotected, passwordless, misconfigured noSql databases exposed on Internet
Indicators of Compromise: Unprotected 4.7 GB Elasticsearch cluster on US-based Amazon AWS server
Unprotected 140+ GB MongoDB database with 808,539,939 email records
MongoDB database with over 200 million Chinese job seeker resumes
Misconfigured passwordless MongoDB instances exposing personal information of 66 million and 11 million individuals
